values: 一名信守誓言的射手，擅长狩猎被击飞的敌人。
A sworn Marksman who excels at hunting enemies knocked into the air.
Wind... perfect. Let the hunt begin.
I still remember... how to fly.
The string... must be drawn taut.
谢谢，我会找个树洞保存它。
Thanks, I'll tuck it into a tree hollow.
这是狩猎成功的奖励吗？
Is this a reward for a successful hunt?
Master, have you been here before?
Too many people... I'm not used to it.
只要能补充体力，吃什么无所谓
As long as it restores strength... I don't care what I eat.
卡兹姆箭术出众，是部族猎手中的翘楚，这得益于他先天敏锐的视力和后天坚持不懈的练习。
Thanks to his keen eyes and tireless practice, Kazim has become one of the tribe's finest hunters, renowned for his unrivaled marksmanship.
因为长期不与人交流，卡兹姆的嗓音沙哑且低沉，说话时语速很慢，仿佛每一个词都需要在喉咙里打磨许久才能吐出。
Kazim's voice is hoarse and deep from infrequent speech. He speaks slowly, as though each word must be carefully measured before it leaves his lips.
卡兹姆从不给鹰戴上鹰帽。虽然这会让驯鹰过程更艰难，但他固执地认为，既然它们已被夺走了翱翔天际的自由，便不该再被剥夺注视这个世界的权利。
Kazim never hoods his falcons. Though it makes taming them far more difficult, he believes that creatures robbed of their freedom should keep at least their vision.
卡兹姆给每一只驯养的鹰都起了名字，名字多与风、云、飞翔有关。当他低声呼唤它们时，那生涩而又充满感情的语调，仿佛是在呼唤故乡的亲人。
Every falcon under Kazim's care carries a name inspired by the sky. When he calls them, his voice softens with affection, as if speaking to his own family.
卡兹姆对疼痛的忍耐力比常人要强。许多次，落在他肩上的鹰隼利爪紧握、刺入皮肉时，他却像是感觉不到一样，只是平静地伸手，安抚着这只或许比他更焦躁的同类。
Kazim has an unusually high pain tolerance. When a falcon's talons tear into his flesh, he does not flinch—instead, he reaches out to gently calm the bird.
经卡兹姆驯养的鹰，即便不被关在笼中，也不会离开主人。
His falcons have never sought to escape, even when left uncaged.
在起风的日子，卡兹姆会从翅膀上拔下一根最细小的羽毛放在窗边，看着它被风带走。这是他唯一的娱乐。
Whenever the wind rises, Kazim plucks the smallest feather from his wings and sets it by the window, watching it drift off on the breeze. It's his only entertainment.
在故乡，卡兹姆习惯于栖息在陡峭的悬崖或高耸的树冠之上。即便来到了赛凡纳，他也无法适应柔软的床铺，而是选择整夜坐在窗台上，维持着一种半梦半醒的警戒姿态休息。
Raised on steep cliffs and treetops, the soft mattresses of Savannah hold little appeal for him. He prefers to settle on the windowsill, staying half-awake through the night.
卡兹姆能模仿几十种鸟类的叫声，从婉转的鸣唱到示警的尖啸。在某些寂静的夜晚，猎场卫兵会听到这种奇怪的鸟鸣合奏，却不知那是养鹰人孤独的自娱自乐。
Kazim can mimic the calls of numerous birds, from soft coos to piercing cries. The strange bird songs that echo through the hunting grounds at night are, in fact, his voice.
卡兹姆对食物不甚挑剔，惯食野味或风干肉制品。当他第一次吃到王子从丝绒陷阱带回的珍馐时，那柔软的口感让他无所适从。
Kazim's diet is dominated by game meat and jerky. When Orion first brought him delicacies from Silken Snare, their tender texture was entirely foreign to his palate.
Master, have you been here before?
只要能补充体力，吃什么无所谓
As long as it restores strength... I don't care what I eat.
